Every failed validation throws; file/JSON errors also propagate.
Token reads are separate: trim, require at least 32 characters and no whitespace.
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. The release resolver validates naming/path structure and file presence; it does
not hash the executable to verify the selected revision. Profile metadata is supplied by
configuration. No engine process or connector endpoint was started.
